purpose: Unapproved exploration references for the designer brief
briefs: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original iOS app icon for Vaultito, a friendly premium personal photo vault. Create one finished square 1024x1024 icon, full-bleed opaque deep plum #271C38 background. A large confident custom coral #FF755F V symbol made of two rounded unequal strokes; one small square negative-space window at its upper-right suggests a photo frame. Beautiful simple vector-like geometry, generous negative space, extremely legible silhouette at 40px, subtle soft tonal depth allowed but mostly flat. Symbol occupies middle 65%. No words, letters other than the abstract V, numbers, badges, padlocks, shields, keys, loops, ribbons, paper textures, borders, outer rounded corners, drop shadow outside tile, mockup or watermark. Original independent identity, warm and approachable rather than enterprise cybersecurity. One icon only, no presentation sheet.

Distinct silhouette, charming precision, thoughtful negative space, simple enough to recognize at 40px; symbol occupies middle 65%. No words, labels, logo sheet, lock/shield/key, loop, folded ribbon, literal document or utility-app disguise. No baked outer corner mask, no border, no external shadows or watermark. One polished icon only.
